data.title: Report card averages are wrong
story: This average function is used for student report cards. For the three scores 80, 90, 100 it gives 135!
Fix the function so it works for any number of scores.

explanation: An average is the total divided by how many items there are, so the divisor must be len(list), not the number 2. That way the function works for any number of scores.
hints: Look at the return line. Why divide by 2?
You can get how many items a list has with len(...).
